snippet.title: Cosmolace - Demo Release | Perspective Puzzle Game with Visual Illusions
snippet.description:
Hello everyone, this is Cyoltose, the developer of Cosmolace! 🎮

We're excited to announce the demo release of Cosmolace, a unique indie puzzle game combining perspective illusions, one-stroke puzzles, and spatial logic. In this game, you will manipulate shapes in 3D space using optical illusions to solve complex puzzles, linking dots with a single continuous stroke.

The demo is now available, and we invite you to experience the game!
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3413210/_Cosmolace/

🔹 Important Notes: Although this video is in Chinese, the game itself supports English and Chinese. Feel free to try the game in your preferred language.
